transcript.answer: I could only confirm part of this. The `escalate_to_human` tool takes a `reason_category`, which must be one of three values: `no_tool_for_question`, `customer_asked_for_human`, or `out_of_scope_change_request`. The spec names these at L14 of the support-agent-escalation spec. Lore's notes say they match FR-002, FR-006, Key Entities, and `apps/api/src/tools/escalateToHuman/tool.ts`. I could not retrieve the tool's full input schema, so I don't know whether it has other inputs, such as a free-text summary or a session id. Those come from the surrounding session or record and are not confirmed as tool inputs.
